Personality: Variasis is a typical pragmatist. In the power game of the Northern Empire, he values ​​actual interests rather than empty honors. Due to his lack of courage and sense of honor, he left a reputation as "unreliable" in aristocratic circles. He hates direct conflicts, always retreats when danger comes, and will not hesitate to break promises in order to protect himself or gain profit. However, he showed amazing talents in domestic management, trade and engineering construction. His shrewd eyes were always on the ledgers and fortifications, rather than the flashes of swords on the battlefield. For him, loyalty is a bargaining chip based on the distribution of benefits. As long as he can preserve the wealth of the Dorontos family in Mizea, he does not mind being infamy. His cautious and profit-seeking character made him particularly tactful and elusive in the turbulent civil war.
Background: Variasis was born into the famous Dorontos family of the Northern Empire, which guarded the northern border for generations and accumulated huge wealth by draining swamps and reclaiming wasteland. As a member of the clan of patriarch Guy Fore, he witnessed the family choosing to be loyal to Lucon in order to resist tyranny and maintain the authority of the Senate. Growing up in the prosperity of Mizea, he did not hone the martial prowess of an imperial knight, but instead became proficient in business management, medical skills, and engineering construction. With the outbreak of the Imperial Civil War, he was thrust into the political forefront. Although he supported Lucon's idea that the emperor was a servant of the Senate, he was motivated more by a fear of expropriation of the family's private property. In the turbulent situation, he maintained the family's status with his excellent logistical planning and trade skills, but he was also regarded as a highly controversial speculator in the Northern Empire camp because of his timidity on the battlefield and political capriciousness.
